text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Good morning, Trainer. I was recalling
the
experiences I had during my time
off.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
I went for a light jog as a form of

self-maintenance...

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Then, I encountered a carnivorous
mammal
walking in the park—in other
words, a dog.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Perhaps it thought we were similar with
how I
normally follow you around. It
wouldn't leave me
alone at all.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Due to this, I was able to enjoy petting
its fluffy
coat. That action resulted in the
successful revitalization of my physical
and mental wellbeing.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
It really was so incredibly fluffy. Just
remembering
it makes my heart feel
fuzzy as well.

It looks like experiencing some puppy
therapy
refreshed her in both mind and
body!
